notes: Revenue (subscription/services/connect) sourced from the LIVE MRR snapshots so every month is current; QuickBooks P&L drives profitability (COGS, margins, CAC, LTV) only for the months it covers (see ttm.pnl_coverage) — recent months show revenue with margins pending the P&L refresh. Unit economics derived from QuickBooks CAC Info P&L × allmoxy_core_customer signups × mrr_by_month logo counts. CAC = (Marketing Payroll + Marketing & Advertising + Sales Expenses + Sales Commission) / new logos. LTV = Avg MRR × Subscription Gross Margin / Monthly Logo Churn Rate. Churn rate derived from Logo Qty deltas and gross signups (aggregate, not per-cohort). All metrics are subscription-only unless stated; services revenue is tracked separately.
